Class FriendshipDbRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.FriendshipDbRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<Tuple<Long,Long>, Friendship>
public class FriendshipDbRepository extends Object implements Repository<Tuple<Long,Long>, Friendship>
PostgreSQL database repository implementation for Friendship entities. Stores symmetric user relationships with canonical ID ordering (id1 < id2).

    • findFriendsOnPage

      public Page<User> findFriendsOnPage(Long userId, Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of friends for a given user using a single SQL JOIN query.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose friends are retrieved, must not be null
      pageable - pagination parameters specifying page number and page size, must not be null
      Returns:
      a Page containing the user's friends on the requested page and the total number of friends
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if userId or pageable is null
      RepositoryException - if a database access error occurs
